note: Both sets capture the same four tower properties from Table 6-2 with correct values, units, and conditions, and both keep the isolated-tower (no rotor-nacelle mass) condition for the damping ratio. Each set redundantly restates three of the four facts: A duplicates height (as 'height above ground' and 'overall height'), CM location, and mass; B duplicates CM location, mass, and the damping ratio (table row plus prose sentence). Neither set misreads or invents anything, and neither omits an important fact, so their overall quality is essentially equal.
remarks: Both extractions emit near-identical duplicate pairs (CM location and integrated mass appear twice in each set); A additionally splits the 87.6 m height into two attribute names, B splits the damping ratio across table and prose. Deduplication would improve both. The prose note that 87.6 m follows from the overall tower height and the DOWEC/Ref. [14] provenance of the damping value are not extracted by either set, but these are minor.
